resources.string: Plays your own video files with English subtitles generated on this device. Speech recognition and translation run offline; the movie never leaves the phone.
Download a speech model and the voice-activity model in the Model Manager first.
Download a Whisper speech model in the Model Manager.
Download the Silero voice-activity model in the Model Manager.
Models are downloaded from pinned addresses and checked with SHA-256 before use. This device has %1$d MB of memory: Whisper base suits 3 GB phones, small suits 4 GB or more.
How far ahead subtitles must be ready before playback starts. Use High Accuracy or Full Movie if your phone is slower than real time.
Automatic detection works for most films; pick the language if it is misdetected (for example Bengali).
Pause playback while subtitles are not ready
Keep translating the whole movie in the background

Publisher: aivicventures. Everything runs on this device: audio is decoded from your video, recognised by Whisper (whisper.cpp) and translated to English, and the results are cached so a movie is never processed twice. Nothing is uploaded. Downloads happen only in the Model Manager.
Only %1$.0f%% of the movie has subtitles so far. Export what is ready?
